name: Kohler C2 Outdoor Sauna Kit - Weathered Grey Spruce | 3, 5 or 6 Person
description: Description Imagine stepping outside at the end of a long day and slipping into a world built entirely for your restoration—a warm, cedar-scented quiet where your shoulders finally drop, your breath deepens, and the rest of the world feels comfortably distant. The soft glow behind the obeche backrest invites you into stillness, and within minutes you feel the shift: grounded, clear, completely renewed. This isn’t just a sauna. It is the moment you reclaim your day, the ritual that steadies your mind, and the wellness anchor your home has been missing. With its Scandinavian spruce interior, weathered grey spruce exterior, and Kohler’s uncompromising engineering, the C2 Outdoor Sauna becomes a physical expression of the identity you’re stepping into—someone who prioritizes longevity, calm, and high-quality living. Why do you think so many high-performers and wellness experts consider daily heat exposure a non-negotiable part of their routine? Because it creates measurable transformation—better sleep, enhanced recovery, reduced stress—and delivers those benefits every single day. And when you’re investing in something that becomes part of your lifestyle, the question isn’t “Can I justify it?” but “How often do I get a chance to make one decision that improves my health for years?” This isn’t a fleeting purchase—it’s a once-and-done upgrade to your home and your well-being. A month from now, picture your new normal: stepping into your private outdoor retreat as the evening cool settles in, warm light illuminating the wood grain, heat enveloping you in a cocoon of calm. Stress dissolves, sleep comes easier, and your home becomes a sanctuary you look forward to returning to every single day. Features Scandinavian Spruce Interior: Spa-quality craftsmanship that creates a serene, grounding environment while elevating the aesthetic of your outdoor space. Freestanding FERO Electric Sauna Heater: Delivers authentic Finnish-style heat for deep relaxation and a traditional sauna experience. Warm White Indirect Lighting: 2700K illumination positioned behind the backrest adds a gentle, therapeutic glow for a calming ambiance. Extended Roof Eaves: Protect the exterior from weather, increase energy efficiency, and add a refined architectural presence. Exterior Perimeter Lighting: Creates an inviting nighttime atmosphere and reinforces the sauna as a centerpiece of your outdoor space. Dual Thermostatic Control: Ensures safe, consistent temperatures—giving you a reliable, repeatable wellness ritual every day. Digital Control Panel: Mounted externally for effortless temperature, session time, and lighting adjustments. Aerotherm Ventilation System: Maintains optimal oxygen levels and air exchange for cleaner, more comfortable sessions. Weathered Grey Spruce Exterior Cladding: Naturally beautiful, durable, and timeless—an organic statement of luxury. Secure Locking Front Door: Protects the sauna from weather and unauthorized access, providing peace of mind. 2.1” Mineral Wool Insulation: Exceptional heat retention for efficient operation and consistent warmth. 0.3” Tempered Glass Door & Windows: Safety-rated, heat-resistant glass offering visibility and architectural elegance. Cool-Touch Beech Door Handles: Stay comfortable during high-heat sessions. Tongue-and-Groove Construction: Creates a seamless, visually polished build while ensuring structural integrity. Multiple Cabin Sizes: Choose models accommodating 3, 5, or 6 people to match your home and lifestyle. What's Included?
